For teachers and tutors

About Translate

A translation game for learners who can read their first language. The learner reads a sentence in Arabic, Burmese, Chinese, Dari, Hindi, Khmer, Pashto, Persian, Thai, Urdu or Vietnamese and writes it in English. In multiple choice they choose the right English sentence. The sentences are about name, family, home, daily routine and the weekend.

How to play

  1. Choose your language.
  2. Read the sentence.
  3. Write it in English, or tap it.

Play it as a class

Choose Translate in the Teacher Game. Each student picks their own language on their phone.

👩‍🏫 Open the Teacher Game
